summary: Regression retest for ChemShield 'Invalid API key' bug. Ran full backend suite (17 existing tests) + 3 new targeted regression tests. All 20 tests PASS. Confirmed: (a) POST /api/scans does not leak 'Invalid API key' — response either returns success fields or a friendly bucket message; (b) GET /api/scans for demo user contains no stale docs with 'Invalid API key' substring (cleanup verified); (c) all previously-passing endpoints (auth register/login/me, google callback rejection, scan CRUD, file download bearer + ?auth= query, cross-user 403, stats summary) still work; (d) static review of create_scan() in server.py confirms the 3-bucket friendly-error mapping (invalid api key/authenticationerror/unauthorized -> temporarily unavailable; timeout -> timed out; else -> could not be completed).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_scan() correctly catches upstream exception and stores only a friendly string, preventing future stale-error leaks — LGTM.
Consider adding a startup sweep that deletes any legacy scan doc whose error field matches /invalid api key/i, as belt-and-suspenders for other environments.
seed_data_creation: None — used auto-seeded demo user. Created transient TEST_ users during test_register_new_user and test_07_other_user_forbidden.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Regression file test_regression_apikey.py should stay in the suite to guard against future re-introduction of raw litellm/openai error leakage. Sample image at /tmp/label.jpg. If missing, re-fetch: curl -s -o /tmp/label.jpg 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1585421514738-01798e348b17?w=800&q=60'.
rca of the issue: Original user report ('showing api key error again') was NOT a live failure — the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is valid and current scans succeed. Root cause was 18 legacy scan documents persisted in db.scans from before the earlier .env fix, each with error='AI analysis failed: ... litellm.AuthenticationError: OpenAIException - Invalid API key'. These surfaced on Dashboard/Scan History and looked like fresh failures. Mitigation applied by main agent: (1) db.scans.deleteMany({error: /Invalid API key/i}) removed 18 stale rows; (2) create_scan() exception handler in server.py now maps litellm/openai errors to one of three friendly non-technical strings before persisting, so raw stack traces can never reach the DB or client again. Verified by 3 new pytest cases + full suite.
